cohort: 2012 women with term PROM (≥37 gestational weeks) at a tertiary medical center between July 2012 and March 2022
finding: The study found no statistically significant difference in cesarean delivery rates between women with certain PROM and uncertain PROM, suggesting that following the same management guidelines for both groups did not compromise maternal or fetal outcomes.
mod_finding: While there was a significant difference in CD due to failed induction on univariate analysis, it was not maintained on multivariate logistic regression.
